info.name: SMemories - notes moderation
info.description: Notes moderation (T-013): `/api/note/get-list`, `batch-update-status`, `reorder` and `batch-delete` on the v2 contract. Uses the three fixed accounts of notes.postman_collection.json (A and B verified, C never verified): run that collection's Setup once and `make verify-newman-users`, or run this one's Setup and the same make target. Run in order from the postman/ directory (`newman run notes-moderation.postman_collection.json --working-dir .`), because one note uploads fixtures/media/photo-gps.jpg. Edge cases reuses the yearbook and notes of the Full flow and ends by deleting the yearbook. A run makes 5 public submissions (limit 100 per IP per hour) and about 10 moderation writes (limit 120 per user per minute); `make reset-limits` clears the limits. Start the API with SMEM_ENV=dev.
